ayahs.arabic: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qad aflaha almuminoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Certainly will the believers have succeeded

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي صَلَاتِهِمۡ خَٰشِعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Allatheena hum fee salatihim khashiAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَنِ ٱللَّغۡوِ مُعۡرِضُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waallatheena hum AAani allaghwi muAAridoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they who turn away from ill speech

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَٰعِلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waallatheena hum lilzzakati faAAiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they who are observant of zakah

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِفُرُوجِهِمۡ حَٰفِظُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waallatheena hum lifuroojihim hafithoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they who guard their private parts

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ
ayahs.translit: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed

ayahs.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ
ayahs.translit: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمۡ وَعَهۡدِهِمۡ رَٰعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waallatheena hum liamanatihim waAAahdihim raAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waallatheena hum AAala salawatihim yuhafithoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they who carefully maintain their prayers

ayahs.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡوَٰرِثُونَ
ayahs.translit: Olaika humu alwarithoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Those are the inheritors

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلۡفِرۡدَوۡسَ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Allatheena yarithoona alfirdawsa hum feeha khalidoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةࣲ مِّن طِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min sulalatin min teenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ نُطۡفَةࣰ فِي قَرَارࣲ مَّكِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Thumma jaAAalnahu nutfatan fee qararin makeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلنُّطۡفَةَ عَلَقَةࣰ فَخَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡعَلَقَةَ مُضۡغَةࣰ فَخَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمُضۡغَةَ عِظَٰمࣰ ا فَكَسَوۡنَا ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ لَحۡمࣰ ا ثُمَّ أَنشَأۡنَٰهُ خَلۡقًا ءَاخَرَۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحۡسَنُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Thumma khalaqna alnnutfata AAalaqatan fakhalaqna alAAalaqata mudghatan fakhalaqna almudghata AAithaman fakasawna alAAithama lahman thumma anshanahu khalqan akhara fatabaraka Allahu ahsanu alkhaliqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
ayahs.translit: Thumma innakum baAAda thalika lamayyitoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then indeed, after that you are to die

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ تُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.translit: Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati tubAAathoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمۡ سَبۡعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلۡخَلۡقِ غَٰفِلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad khalaqna fawqakum sabAAa taraiqa wama kunna AAani alkhalqi ghafileena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءَۢ بِقَدَرࣲ فَأَسۡكَنَّٰهُ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابِۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waanzalna mina alssamai maan biqadarin faaskannahu fee alardi wainna AAala thahabin bihi laqadiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنشَأۡنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتࣲ مِّن نَّخِيلࣲ وَأَعۡنَٰبࣲ لَّكُمۡ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةࣱ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faanshana lakum bihi jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin lakum feeha fawakihu katheeratun waminha takuloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat

ayahs.arabic: وَشَجَرَةࣰ تَخۡرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيۡنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهۡنِ وَصِبۡغࣲ لِّلۡأٓكِلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Washajaratan takhruju min toori saynaa tanbutu bialdduhni wasibghin lilakileena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ لَعِبۡرَةࣰۖ نُّسۡقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةࣱ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wainna lakum fee alanAAami laAAibratan nusqeekum mimma fee butooniha walakum feeha manafiAAu katheeratun waminha takuloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat

ayahs.arabic: وَعَلَيۡهَا وَعَلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ تُحۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: WaAAalayha waAAala alfulki tuhmaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And upon them and on ships you are carried

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥٓۚ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad arsalna noohan ila qawmihi faqala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَوۡمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةࣰ مَّا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِيٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faqala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yureedu an yatafaddala AAalaykum walaw shaa Allahu laanzala malaikatan ma samiAAna bihatha fee abaina alawwaleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers

ayahs.arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلُۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةࣱ فَتَرَبَّصُواْ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: In huwa illa rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihi hatta heenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me

ayahs.arabic: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِ أَنِ ٱصۡنَعِ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَا وَوَحۡيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمۡرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ فَٱسۡلُكۡ فِيهَا مِن كُلࣲّ زَوۡجَيۡنِ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ وَأَهۡلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبۡنِي فِي ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ إِنَّهُم مُّغۡرَقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faawhayna ilayhi ani isnaAAi alfulka biaAAyunina wawahyina faitha jaa amruna wafara alttannooru faosluk feeha min kullin zawjayni ithnayni waahlaka illa man sabaqa AAalayhi alqawlu minhum wala tukhatibnee fee allatheena thalamoo innahum mughraqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱسۡتَوَيۡتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ فَقُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faitha istawayta anta waman maAAaka AAala alfulki faquli alhamdu lillahi allathee najjana mina alqawmi alththalimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people

ayahs.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلۡنِي مُنزَلࣰ ا مُّبَارَكࣰ ا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمُنزِلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Waqul rabbi anzilnee munzalan mubarakan waanta khayru almunzileena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us]

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبۡتَلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Inna fee thalika laayatin wain kunna lamubtaleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants]

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قَرۡنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.translit: Thumma anshana min baAAdihim qarnan akhareena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then We produced after them a generation of others

ayahs.arabic: فَأَرۡسَلۡنَا فِيهِمۡ رَسُولࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنۡ إِلَٰهٍ غَيۡرُهُۥٓۚ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faarsalna feehim rasoolan minhum ani oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِن قَوۡمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَأَتۡرَفۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يَأۡكُلُ مِمَّا تَأۡكُلُونَ مِنۡهُ وَيَشۡرَبُ مِمَّا تَشۡرَبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waqala almalao min qawmihi allatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biliqai alakhirati waatrafnahum fee alhayati alddunya ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yakulu mimma takuloona minhu wayashrabu mimma tashraboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink

ayahs.arabic: وَلَئِنۡ أَطَعۡتُم بَشَرࣰ ا مِّثۡلَكُمۡ إِنَّكُمۡ إِذࣰ ا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walain ataAAtum basharan mithlakum innakum ithan lakhasiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers

ayahs.arabic: أَيَعِدُكُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ إِذَا مِتُّمۡ وَكُنتُمۡ تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخۡرَجُونَ
ayahs.translit: AyaAAidukum annakum itha mittum wakuntum turaban waAAithaman annakum mukhrajoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]

ayahs.arabic: ۞هَيۡهَاتَ هَيۡهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Hayhata hayhata lima tooAAadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: How far, how far, is that which you are promised

ayahs.arabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَبۡعُوثِينَ
ayahs.translit: In hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namootu wanahya wama nahnu bimabAAootheena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected

ayahs.arabic: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبࣰ ا وَمَا نَحۡنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤۡمِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: In huwa illa rajulun iftara AAala Allahi kathiban wama nahnu lahu bimumineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرۡنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
ayahs.translit: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلࣲ لَّيُصۡبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qala AAamma qaleelin layusbihunna nadimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ غُثَآءࣰۚ فَبُعۡدࣰ ا لِّلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu bialhaqqi fajaAAalnahum ghuthaan fabuAAdan lilqawmi alththalimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأۡنَا مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.translit: Thumma anshana min baAAdihim quroonan akhareena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then We produced after them other generations

ayahs.arabic: مَا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter]

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرۡسَلۡنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتۡرَاۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةࣰ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُۖ فَأَتۡبَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُم بَعۡضࣰ ا وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ أَحَادِيثَۚ فَبُعۡدࣰ ا لِّقَوۡمࣲ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Thumma arsalna rusulana tatra kulla ma jaa ommatan rasooluha kaththaboohu faatbaAAna baAAdahum baAAdan wajaAAalnahum ahadeetha fabuAAdan liqawmin la yuminoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.translit: Thumma arsalna moosa waakhahu haroona biayatina wasultanin mubeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ وَكَانُواْ قَوۡمًا عَالِينَ
ayahs.translit: Ila firAAawna wamalaihi faistakbaroo wakanoo qawman AAaleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ لِبَشَرَيۡنِ مِثۡلِنَا وَقَوۡمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faqaloo anuminu libasharayni mithlina waqawmuhuma lana AAabidoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُهۡلَكِينَ
ayahs.translit: Fakaththaboohuma fakanoo mina almuhlakeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So they denied them and were of those destroyed

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba laAAallahum yahtadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلۡنَا ٱبۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةࣰ وَءَاوَيۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبۡوَةࣲ ذَاتِ قَرَارࣲ وَمَعِينࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: WajaAAalna ibna maryama waommahu ayatan waawaynahuma ila rabwatin thati qararin wamaAAeenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُواْ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعۡمَلُواْ صَٰلِحًاۖ إِنِّي بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ عَلِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Ya ayyuha alrrusulu kuloo mina alttayyibati waiAAmaloo salihan innee bima taAAmaloona AAaleemun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمۡ أُمَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمۡ فَٱتَّقُونِ
ayahs.translit: Wainna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faittaqooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me

ayahs.arabic: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ زُبُرࣰ اۖ كُلُّ حِزۡبِۭ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُونَ
ayahs.translit: FataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing

ayahs.arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَتِهِمۡ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
ayahs.translit: Fatharhum fee ghamratihim hatta heenin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So leave them in their confusion for a time

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالࣲ وَبَنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Ayahsaboona annama numidduhum bihi min malin wabaneena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children

ayahs.arabic: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِۚ بَل لَّا يَشۡعُرُونَ
ayahs.translit: NusariAAu lahum fee alkhayrati bal la yashAAuroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Inna allatheena hum min khashyati rabbihim mushfiqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waallatheena hum biayati rabbihim yuminoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمۡ لَا يُشۡرِكُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waallatheena hum birabbihim la yushrikoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَواْ وَّقُلُوبُهُمۡ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ رَٰجِعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waallatheena yutoona ma ataw waquloobuhum wajilatun annahum ila rabbihim rajiAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord

ayahs.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِ وَهُمۡ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Olaika yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wahum laha sabiqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ وَلَدَيۡنَا كِتَٰبࣱ يَنطِقُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wala nukallifu nafsan illa wusAAaha waladayna kitabun yantiqu bialhaqqi wahum la yuthlamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged

ayahs.arabic: بَلۡ قُلُوبُهُمۡ فِي غَمۡرَةࣲ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلࣱ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمۡ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratin min hatha walahum aAAmalun min dooni thalika hum laha AAamiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذۡنَا مُتۡرَفِيهِم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمۡ يَجۡـَٔرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Hatta itha akhathna mutrafeehim bialAAathabi itha hum yajaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help

ayahs.arabic: لَا تَجۡـَٔرُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: La tajaroo alyawma innakum minna la tunsaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped

ayahs.arabic: قَدۡ كَانَتۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنتُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡقَٰبِكُمۡ تَنكِصُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qad kanat ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum AAala aAAqabikum tankisoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels

ayahs.arabic: مُسۡتَكۡبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرࣰ ا تَهۡجُرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Mustakbireena bihi samiran tahjuroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil

ayahs.arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَدَّبَّرُواْ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ أَمۡ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمۡ يَأۡتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Afalam yaddabbaroo alqawla am jaahum ma lam yati abaahumu alawwaleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ لَمۡ يَعۡرِفُواْ رَسُولَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am lam yaAArifoo rasoolahum fahum lahu munkiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةُۢۚ بَلۡ جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am yaqooloona bihi jinnatun bal jaahum bialhaqqi waaktharuhum lilhaqqi karihoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡحَقُّ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّۚ بَلۡ أَتَيۡنَٰهُم بِذِكۡرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِهِم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walawi ittabaAAa alhaqqu ahwaahum lafasadati alssamawatu waalardu waman feehinna bal ataynahum bithikrihim fahum AAan thikrihim muAAridoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ خَرۡجࣰ ا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرࣱۖ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Am tasaluhum kharjan fakharaju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru alrraziqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Wainnaka latadAAoohum ila siratin mustaqeemin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wainna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati AAani alssirati lanakiboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path

ayahs.arabic: ۞وَلَوۡ رَحِمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَكَشَفۡنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرࣲّ لَّلَجُّواْ فِي طُغۡيَٰنِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walaw rahimnahum wakashafna ma bihim min durrin lalajjoo fee tughyanihim yaAAmahoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسۡتَكَانُواْ لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad akhathnahum bialAAathabi fama istakanoo lirabbihim wama yatadarraAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم بَابࣰ ا ذَا عَذَابࣲ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ
ayahs.translit: Hatta itha fatahna AAalayhim baban tha AAathabin shadeedin itha hum feehi mublisoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلࣰ ا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wahuwa allathee anshaa lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wahuwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخۡتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wahuwa allathee yuhyee wayumeetu walahu ikhtilafu allayli waalnnahari afala taAAqiloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason

ayahs.arabic: بَلۡ قَالُواْ مِثۡلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Bal qaloo mithla ma qala alawwaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا نَحۡنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبۡلُ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Laqad wuAAidna nahnu waabaona hatha min qablu in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples

ayahs.arabic: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qul limani alardu waman feeha in kuntum taAAlamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know

ayahs.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِۚ قُلۡ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tathakkaroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبۡعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Qul man rabbu alssamawati alssabAAi warabbu alAAarshi alAAatheemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne

ayahs.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِۚ قُلۡ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.translit: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tattaqoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will say, "[They belong] to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him

ayahs.arabic: قُلۡ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيۡهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qul man biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wahuwa yujeeru wala yujaru AAalayhi in kuntum taAAlamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know

ayahs.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِۚ قُلۡ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسۡحَرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul faanna tusharoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded

ayahs.arabic: بَلۡ أَتَيۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Bal ataynahum bialhaqqi wainnahum lakathiboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars

ayahs.arabic: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدࣲ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍۚ إِذࣰ ا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهِۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.translit: Ma ittakhatha Allahu min waladin wama kana maAAahu min ilahin ithan lathahaba kullu ilahin bima khalaqa walaAAala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin subhana Allahi AAamma yasifoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him]

ayahs.arabic: عَٰلِمِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
ayahs.translit: AAalimi alghaybi waalshshahadati fataAAala AAamma yushrikoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him]

ayahs.arabic: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّي مَا يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qul rabbi imma turiyannee ma yooAAadoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised

ayahs.arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجۡعَلۡنِي فِي ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Rabbi fala tajAAalnee fee alqawmi alththalimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمۡ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Wainna AAala an nuriyaka ma naAAiduhum laqadiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them

ayahs.arabic: ٱدۡفَعۡ بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَۚ نَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.translit: IdfaAA biallatee hiya ahsanu alssayyiata nahnu aAAlamu bima yasifoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe

ayahs.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنۡ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
ayahs.translit: Waqul rabbi aAAoothu bika min hamazati alshshayateeni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils

ayahs.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحۡضُرُونِ
ayahs.translit: WaaAAoothu bika rabbi an yahdurooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرۡجِعُونِ
ayahs.translit: Hatta itha jaa ahadahumu almawtu qala rabbi irjiAAooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back

ayahs.arabic: لَعَلِّيٓ أَعۡمَلُ صَٰلِحࣰ ا فِيمَا تَرَكۡتُۚ كَلَّآۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَاۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرۡزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.translit: LaAAallee aAAmalu salihan feema taraktu kalla innaha kalimatun huwa qailuha wamin waraihim barzakhun ila yawmi yubAAathoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori fala ansaba baynahum yawmaithin wala yatasaaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another

ayahs.arabic: فَمَن ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faman thaqulat mawazeenuhu faolaika humu almuflihoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful

ayahs.arabic: وَمَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ فِي جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waman khaffat mawazeenuhu faolaika allatheena khasiroo anfusahum fee jahannama khalidoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally

ayahs.arabic: تَلۡفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمۡ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ
ayahs.translit: Talfahu wujoohahumu alnnaru wahum feeha kalihoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.translit: Alam takun ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum biha tukaththiboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتۡ عَلَيۡنَا شِقۡوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوۡمࣰ ا ضَآلِّينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo rabbana ghalabat AAalayna shiqwatuna wakunna qawman dalleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray

ayahs.arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَخۡرِجۡنَا مِنۡهَا فَإِنۡ عُدۡنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Rabbana akhrijna minha fain AAudna fainna thalimoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ ٱخۡسَـُٔواْ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
ayahs.translit: Qala ikhsaoo feeha wala tukallimooni

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقࣱ مِّنۡ عِبَادِي يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَٱرۡحَمۡنَا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Innahu kana fareequn min AAibadee yaqooloona rabbana amanna faighfir lana wairhamna waanta khayru alrrahimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful

ayahs.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذۡتُمُوهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرِي وَكُنتُم مِّنۡهُمۡ تَضۡحَكُونَ
ayahs.translit: Faittakhathtumoohum sikhriyyan hatta ansawkum thikree wakuntum minhum tadhakoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّي جَزَيۡتُهُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡفَآئِزُونَ
ayahs.translit: Innee jazaytuhumu alyawma bima sabaroo annahum humu alfaizoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]

ayahs.arabic: قَٰلَ كَمۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qala kam labithtum fee alardi AAadada sineena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ لَبِثۡنَا يَوۡمًا أَوۡ بَعۡضَ يَوۡمࣲ فَسۡـَٔلِ ٱلۡعَآدِّينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo labithna yawman aw baAAda yawmin faisali alAAaddeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate

ayahs.arabic: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا قَلِيلࣰ اۖ لَّوۡ أَنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qala in labithtum illa qaleelan law annakum kuntum taAAlamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known

ayahs.arabic: أَفَحَسِبۡتُمۡ أَنَّمَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ عَبَثࣰ ا وَأَنَّكُمۡ إِلَيۡنَا لَا تُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Afahasibtum annama khalaqnakum AAabathan waannakum ilayna la turjaAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned

ayahs.arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
ayahs.translit: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu alAAarshi alkareemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن يَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرۡهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.translit: Waman yadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara la burhana lahu bihi fainnama hisabuhu AAinda rabbihi innahu la yuflihu alkafiroona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed

ayahs.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ وَٱرۡحَمۡ وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Waqul rabbi ighfir wairham waanta khayru alrrahimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful
